said.q: The work is a photolithograph realized by the great Italian master of the XX Century Giorgio Morandi and depicts two small volumes realized with two simple and effective spots of grey color.

events.n: offset print from the volume; text by Lamberto Vitali
events.q: From the volume "L'Opera grafica di Giorgio Morandi", text by Lamberto Vitali, printed in Ilte, Tourin, 1973.
Our copy was printed in Giorgio Upiglio's press.
